PROGRAM return review

TYPE ReturnStatus is "new" | "approved" | "needs_review"

RECORD ReturnRequest
  days_since_purchase: integer

RECORD ReturnDecision
  status: ReturnStatus
  reason: "new" | "within_window" | "outside_window"

REQUEST review return
  GIVEN item is ReturnRequest

  GIVEN decision is ReturnDecision
    status: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN review item into decision

  OUTPUT decision is ReturnDecision

  THEN decision.status != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

task: Complete the existing return-review request. Items returned within 30 days are approved; later returns require review. Preserve its public vocabulary and explicit initial state, then add boundary scenarios for days 30 and 31.

PROGRAM incident triage

TYPE IncidentSeverity is "normal" | "degraded" | "critical"
TYPE IncidentPriority is "new" | "routine" | "review" | "urgent"

RECORD IncidentRequest
  severity: IncidentSeverity
  customer_outage: boolean

RECORD IncidentDecision
  priority: IncidentPriority
  reason: "new" | "normal_operations" | "degraded_service" | "customer_outage"

REQUEST triage incident
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest

  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
    priority: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN triage incident into decision

  OUTPUT decision is IncidentDecision

  THEN decision.priority != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

task: Complete the existing incident-triage request. A customer outage or critical severity is urgent, degraded service without an outage needs review, and normal service is routine. Preserve its public vocabulary; outage precedence must be executable and scenario-covered.

PROGRAM order fulfillment slice

RECORD FulfillmentRequest
  requested_units: integer
  available_units: integer

RECORD FulfillmentDecision
  status: "new" | "fulfilled" | "partial" | "backordered"
  reserved_units: integer
  backordered_units: integer

REQUEST fulfill order
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest

  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0

  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment

  OUTPUT fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision

  THEN fulfillment.status != "new"

task: Complete the existing fulfillment request. Reserve every requested unit when stock is sufficient, produce explicit partial counts when some stock exists, and backorder every unit when none exists. Preserve its public vocabulary and add scenarios for all three states.

PROGRAM funding eligibility slice

RECORD FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: boolean
  previously_funded: boolean
  institution_eligible: boolean

RECORD FundingDecision
  outcome: "new" | "funded" | "not_funded"
  reason: "new" | "unfunded_cohort" | "previously_funded" | "eligible" | "ineligible_institution"

REQUEST assess funding
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  OUTPUT decision is FundingDecision

  THEN decision.outcome != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

task: Complete the existing funding request with explicit precedence: an unfunded cohort wins first, previous funding wins next, then institution eligibility decides funding. Preserve its public vocabulary and add scenarios that prove overlapping facts select the earlier reason.

PROGRAM semantic release slice

RECORD CommitFacts
  breaking_change: boolean
  feature: boolean
  fix: boolean

RECORD ReleaseDecision
  level: "new" | "major" | "minor" | "patch" | "none"

REQUEST analyze commit
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts

  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
    level: "new"

  WHEN analyze commit into release

  OUTPUT release is ReleaseDecision

  THEN release.level != "new"

task: Complete the existing semantic-release request. Breaking changes are major even when also features, features are minor even when also fixes, fixes are patch, and irrelevant commits produce no release. Preserve its public vocabulary and prove precedence with scenarios.

WHEN mark known item from <items> into <result>
  FIND item in items WHERE item == "known"
    set result to item

SCENARIO known item is selected
GIVEN items is ["known"]
GIVEN result is "missing"
WHEN mark known item from items into result
THEN result == "known"

WHEN record waiting <days> into <total>
  GIVEN days is integer
  AND total is integer
  add days to total

SCENARIO waiting days are counted
GIVEN days is "five"
GIVEN total is 0
WHEN record waiting days into total
THEN total == 5

RECORD Applicant
  name: text
  referral: optional<text>

WHEN classify <applicant> into <status>

  IF applicant.referral == "trusted"
    set status to "approved"
  ELSE
    set status to "review"

SCENARIO missing referral requires review
GIVEN applicant is Applicant
  name: "Ada"
GIVEN status is "new"
WHEN classify applicant into status
THEN status == "review"
